references.text: The preceding verse that introduces the list of unclean creeping things that move on the ground and provides context for the enumeration of specific animals.
The following verses explain that these creeping things make a person unclean by touch and provide the practical application of the list.
A parallel list of clean and unclean animals in Deuteronomy, which repeats and expands upon the rules for edible and non-edible animals.
Further instructions regarding unclean creeping things, including anything that crawls on its belly or has many feet.
Isaiah refers to those who eat unclean animals, including lizards and mice, as a sign of idolatry and uncleanness.
